observations: Photo 0 shows a white and grey photocopier with the lid open, revealing the glass document feeder and control panel. The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-5516' are clearly visible on the front panel.

Photo 1 shows the same machine from a side angle, with the lid open, revealing the document feeder and control panel. The machine appears to be in a room with tiled flooring and visible wear on the side casing.

Photo 2 shows the machine from a front-side angle, with the lid open, revealing the document feeder and control panel. The machine has visible dust and grime, especially on the side casing and around the document feeder.
The control panel in all photos includes a numeric keypad, function buttons, and a small display screen. The machine appears to be a multifunction printer/copier.
No power cord or plug is visible in any photo. The machine is not shown connected to power or in operation.
The seller's text mentions 'Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.' This is not visually verifiable from the photos.

claims.claim: Selling a Sharp AR-5516 Digital Photocopier
claims.evidence: The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-5516' are clearly visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 2.

claims.claim: ideal for office use, business centers, cybercafes
claims.evidence: This is a subjective claim about suitability; no visual evidence supports or contradicts it.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, scanning, copying, and printing a test page.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged power cord or plug
risks.proof: Photo of the power cord and plug, showing condition and length.

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage to internal components (e.g., drum, fuser, rollers)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal components, especially the drum and fuser area, and a video of the machine operating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential internal wear

risks.risk: Machine may have been used in a non-ideal environment (e.g., dusty, wet, or with poor ventilation)
risks.proof: Photo of the machine's interior and exterior, showing cleanliness and condition of ventilation grills and casing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially dusty or poorly maintained

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and performing a test scan, copy, and print.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up photos of the internal components (drum, fuser, rollers).
Photo of the machine's interior and exterior, showing cleanliness and condition of ventilation grills.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
